definition_zh_all: 颂词， 称赞， 礼物； 贡品

example.en: Early promises to end Indian tribute and taxes on people of mixed origin came much slower because the new nations still needed the revenue such policies produced.
example.zh: 早期关于结束印第安人贡赋和对混血人群征税的承诺落实得慢得多，因为这些新国家仍然需要这类政策带来的收入。
example.source: 真题 2007英语·cloze·完形原句（按答案还原）

example.en: The trick is to direct these funds better.
example.zh: 诀窍在于更好地引导这些资金。

phrases.zh: 不招待就使坏（指万圣节孩子们挨家逐户要糖果等礼物，如不遂愿便恶作剧一番的风俗）
帽子戏法（指连入三球），[板球]连中三柱（使对方三击球手退场）
高明的把戏；聪明的花招；熟练的伎俩

example.en: An Antwerp port authority spokesman said electricians came out in support, reducing ship movements to a trickle.
example.zh: 安特卫普港务局发言人说，电工们出来表示支持，使船只往来减少到寥寥无几。

definition_zh_all: 琐事，小事，无价值的东西

example.en: You will probably never think of fashion as a trifle again.
example.zh: 你大概再也不会把时尚当作一件小事了。
example.source: 真题 2024四级·06月·第3套·Section C·正文

phrases.zh: 玩弄；视同儿戏；心不在焉地做

example.en: Other life changes can trigger periods of loneliness too, such as retirement, changing jobs or becoming a parent.
example.zh: 其他生活变化也可能引发孤独期，比如退休、换工作或成为父母。
example.source: 真题 2024英语二·cloze·第8题·完形原句（按答案还原）

example.en: College loan balances in the U.S. now stand at a record $1.5 trillion, according to the Federal Reserve.
example.zh: 根据美联储的数据，美国大学贷款余额目前达到创纪录的1.5万亿美元。

example.en: J. She trimmed back my flowery language, drew lines through my exclamation marks and argued for the value of restraint in expression." John," she almost whispered.
example.zh: J. 她删减了我华丽的辞藻，在我的感叹号上划了线，并主张表达中克制的重要性。“约翰，”她几乎是耳语道。
example.source: 真题 2015四级·12月·第3套·Section B·正文

phrases.zh: 未准备好；失去平衡；健康情况不佳

definition_zh_all: 三部分的，三方的；三倍的，三重的

example.en: The unpaid housework done by women is triple that done by men.
example.zh: 女性所做的无偿家务劳动是男性的三倍。
example.source: 真题 2021四级·12月·第1套·Section B·第37题·题干

phrases.zh: 三联点；三重接头；三向连接构造
三A（由三个表现出众的草坪型高羊茅品种科学配比而成，是市场上很受欢迎的高羊茅混播组合）；三A级；最高信用评级；美国汽车协会（AAA，American Automobile Association）
三杀（使攻方三个球员同时被杀出局）

example.en: If the small hot spots look as expected, that will be a triumph for yet another scientific idea, a refinement of the Big Bang called the inflationary universe theory.
example.zh: 如果这些小热点看起来与预期相符，那将是又一个科学理念的胜利，即对大爆炸理论的完善，称为暴胀宇宙理论。

phrases.zh: 胜利地；洋洋得意地；耀武扬威地

words.category: 重要性、必要性与价值评价

example.en: “In this era of choice, entertainment media are what captures hearts and minds,” Kim writes. “Its political consequences are anythingbut trivial”.
example.zh: “在这个充满选择的时代，娱乐媒体才是俘获人心与思想的东西，”金写道，“其政治后果绝非微不足道。”
example.source: 真题 2024六级·06月·第2套·Section C·正文

phrases.zh: 无关重要的事情（trivial matter的复数形式）

example.en: Tom queued behind an old biddy with a full trolley.
example.zh: 汤姆排在一个推着满满一购物车东西的老太婆后面。

example.en: The Olympic suffered two crashes with other ships and went on to serve as a hospital ship and troop transport in World War I. Eventually, she was taken out of service in 1935, ending the era of the luxurious Olympic class ocean liners.
example.zh: 奥林匹克号曾与其他船只发生过两次碰撞，随后在第一次世界大战中作为医院船和运兵船服役。最终，她于1935年退役，结束了豪华奥林匹克级远洋客轮的时代。
example.source: 真题 2018四级·06月·第2套·Section C·正文

example.en: Both sides are hoping to win the competition for a record third time, and so keep the trophy for good.
example.zh: 双方都希望创纪录地第三次赢得这项比赛，从而永久保留奖杯。

example.en: Switzerland has alpine regions loftier and more imposing, Russia vaster steppes, and Norway more arctic scenery: but nowhere else in Europe do arctic and tropic so nearly meet as in Spain.
example.zh: 瑞士有更高耸雄伟的高山地区，俄罗斯有更辽阔的草原，挪威有更多北极风光：但在欧洲其他地方，北极与热带风情都不像在西班牙那样几乎交汇。

phrases.zh: 热带森林，热带雨林；热带林
热带；热带区域；热带载重线区

definition_zh_all: 令人烦恼的， 麻烦的

example.en: It is all very well train operators trumpeting the improvements they are making to the network, but passengers should be able to expect a basic level of service for the substantial sums they are now paying to travel.
example.zh: 铁路运营商大肆宣扬他们对铁路网所做的改进固然很好，但乘客既然支付了高额费用出行，就理应能够期待基本的服务水平。

definition_zh_all: 桶， 塑料杯， 纸杯； 盆， 洗澡盆， 浴缸

example.en: In the checkout line at a supermarket in downtown Nairobi, a conveyor belt moves bags of potato chips, snack foods, processed meats and cheeses, tubs of margarine and bottles of cooking oil.
example.zh: 在内罗毕市中心一家超市的收银队伍中，传送带运送着薯片袋、零食、加工肉类和奶酪、人造黄油桶以及食用油瓶。

definition_zh_all: 把边塞到下面；把…夹入，把…藏入

example.en: But once we rip off the band-aid, tuck our smartphones in our pockets and look up, it doesn’t hurt so bad.
example.zh: 但一旦我们撕掉创可贴，把智能手机塞进口袋，抬起头来，其实也没那么难受。
example.source: 真题 2015英语二·cloze·完形原句（按答案还原）

phrases.zh: 塔克修士（罗宾汉传说中的人物，是罗宾汉的牧师兼管家）

definition_zh_all: 拖船； 猛拉， 牵引

example.en: Wages are influenced by a tug of war between employers and workers, and employers have been winning.
example.zh: 工资受雇主与工人之间拉锯战的影响，而雇主一直占上风。
example.source: 真题 2023六级·12月·第1套·Section C·正文

phrases.zh: 拔河，拔河比赛；两派间的激烈竞争

definition_zh_all: 教学， 讲授， 指导； 学费

example.en: We are thus led to distinguish, within the broad educational process which we have been so far considering, a more formal kind of education – that of direct tuition or schooling.
example.zh: 因此，我们在迄今所考虑的广泛教育过程中，被引导去区分一种更为正式的教育——即直接授课或学校教育。

definition_zh_all: 跌倒，摔下，滚下；翻滚；暴跌；不由自主地卷入

example.en: Every swell at its crest wanted to take us for a tumble, but the anchors, beyond the crest, heaved mightily and pulled us through, but at the expense of pulling the front of the boat down.
example.zh: 每一道涌浪的浪峰都想把我们掀翻，但锚在浪峰之外，猛烈地拉起，把我们拉了过去，但代价是把船头往下拽。
example.source: 真题 2025专八·阅读·PASSAGE THREE·正文

example.en: Historians, especially those so blinded by their research interests that they have been accused of “tunnel method,” frequently fall victim to the “technical fallacy.”
example.zh: 历史学家，尤其是那些被自己的研究兴趣蒙蔽、以至于被指责为“隧道式方法”的人，常常成为“技术谬误”的受害者。

phrases.zh: 水洞；水槽，水筒；输水隧道
[解]腕隧道；屈肌管；腕道症候群
隧道掘进机；隧道钻巷机；隧道开挖机

definition_zh_all: 动荡的， 混乱的； 汹涌的， 狂暴的

example.en: A turbulent business environment also has senior managers cautious of letting vague pronouncements cloud their reputations.
example.zh: 动荡的商业环境也会让高级管理人员谨慎行事，避免含糊的表态损害自己的声誉。

example.en: The turmoil on the ground in physical retail is hard to square with the Census data.
example.zh: 实体零售业现场的动荡局面很难与人口普查数据相符。
example.source: 真题 2019六级·06月·第1套·Section B·正文

example.en: Whereas the Scots voted overwhelmingly for a parliament, the vote for a Welsh assembly scraped through by less than one percent on a turnout of less than 25 percent.
example.zh: 尽管苏格兰人以压倒性多数投票支持成立议会，但威尔士议会方案的投票仅以不到一个百分点的优势勉强通过，投票率不足25%。
example.source: 真题 2007专八·阅读·Text A·正文

definition_zh_all: 营业额， 成交量； 人员调整， 人员更替率

example.en: In the third quarter, CEO turnover was down 23% from a year ago as nervous boards stuck with the leaders they had, according to Liberum Research.
example.zh: 根据Liberum Research的数据，第三季度CEO更替率同比下降23%，因为紧张的董事会选择留任现有领导人。

phrases.zh: 年营业额，年成交量；年总生物量

example.en: In this position — water pouring in, water pouring out — the tarpaulin beat me to a pulp, I was soaked and chilled, and I was bruised and cut by bones and turtle shells.
example.zh: 在这个位置——水灌进来，水又涌出去——防水布把我打得稀烂，我浑身湿透、冷得发抖，还被骨头和龟壳撞得青一块紫一块、划出伤口。
example.source: 真题 2025专八·阅读·PASSAGE THREE·正文

phrases.zh: 忍者神龟（美国动画电影）

definition_zh_all: 当…导师， 当…家庭教师
导师；家庭教师，私人教师

example.en: How does teaching others benefit student tutors?
example.zh: 教别人如何使担任辅导者的学生受益？
example.source: 真题 2018四级·06月·第3套·Section C·第48题·题干

phrases.zh: n. 城市贫穷地区；界限分明的两者之间的模糊状态

definition_zh_all: 缠绕，盘绕；转动，旋动；捻，搓；歪曲，曲解；扭歪，扭伤；曲折前进；转身
扭弯； 转折， 转变； 弯曲， 曲折处

example.en: Whichever it is, you know every twist and turn like the back of your hand.
example.zh: 无论是什么，你对每一个曲折转弯都了如指掌。

definition_zh_all: 典型的， 有代表性的

example.en: A typical digital SLR camera shoots 20 frames a second.
example.zh: 一台典型的数码单反相机每秒拍摄20帧。
example.source: 真题 2025英语一·ordering·第43题·B选项·选项

phrases.zh: 典型值；范值；代表值；平均数

example.en: This phenomenon has created serious concerns over the role of smaller economic firms, of national businessmen and over the ultimate stability of the world economy.
example.zh: 这一现象引发了对小型经济企业、民族商人作用的严重担忧，以及对世界经济最终稳定性的担忧。

phrases.zh: 极限承载力，极限承载量；轴承极限能力，承载量
[电]极限容量；[电]总功率；最终产量

example.en: Shin-Etsu Chemical Co Ltd said it had developed an ultra thermal resistance rubber which can be used at 250 centigrade continuously without losing its properties.
example.zh: 信越化学工业株式会社表示，已开发出一种超耐热橡胶，可在250摄氏度下连续使用而不丧失其性能。

phrases.zh: 超声波测试；超声波探伤法
超声波清洗；超声波消磁
紫外吸收；紫外线吸收；紫外光吸收
紫外线激光器，紫外激光器；紫外雷射
太阳紫外辐射；阳光紫外缐照射

definition_zh_all: 全体一致的， 一致同意的

example.en: In a rare unanimous ruling, the US Supreme Court has overturned the corruption conviction of a former Virginia governor, Robert McDonnell.
example.zh: 在一项罕见的一致裁决中，美国最高法院推翻了前弗吉尼亚州州长罗伯特·麦克唐纳的腐败定罪。

phrases.zh: 不偏估计，公正（无偏）评价

example.en: is faced with uncertain prospects.
example.zh: 面临不确定的前景。
example.source: 真题 2020英语一·Text 4·第39题·B选项·选项

example.en: But she underestimates the educational value of zoos.
example.zh: 但她低估了动物园的教育价值。

definition_zh_all: 经历， 经受， 忍受； 接受
经历； 经受， 忍受

example.en: … the early industrialized countries of Europe the process of industrialization—with all the far-reaching changes in social patterns that followed—was spread over nearly a century, whereas nowadays a developing nation may undergo the same process in a decade or so.
example.zh: ……欧洲早期工业化国家的工业化进程——连同随之而来的社会模式中所有影响深远的变化——持续了将近一个世纪，而如今一个发展中国家可能在大约十年内经历同样的进程。

example.en: … believe that the most important forces behind the massive M&A wave are the same that underlie the globalization process: falling transportation and communication costs, lower trade and investment barriers and enlarged markets that require enlarged operations capable of meeting customers' demands.
example.zh: 认为大规模并购浪潮背后最重要的推动力与全球化进程的根本驱动力相同：运输和通信成本下降、贸易和投资壁垒降低，以及需要能够满足客户需求的扩大化经营的市场扩大。

definition_zh_all: 在…下面画线； 强调， 使…突出

example.en: The idea that one might bum down an entire house just to reclaim the nails underlines how scarce, costly and valuable the simple-seeming technology was.
example.zh: 为了回收钉子而烧掉整栋房子的想法，凸显了这种看似简单的技术当时多么稀缺、昂贵和珍贵。

definition_zh_all: 在下面的； 含蓄的； 潜在的

phrases.zh: 标的资产；基础资产；相关/指定资产
[金融]标的证券；附属公司证券

definition_zh_all: 暗中破坏， 逐渐削弱； 侵蚀…的基础

example.en: She uses outdated research and decades-old examples to undermine the noble mission of organizations committed to connecting children to a world beyond their own.
example.zh: 她使用过时的研究和几十年前的例子来削弱那些致力于让孩子接触自身之外世界的组织的崇高使命。

definition_zh_all: 从事； 承担； 同意； 保证
words.category: 通用动词(难以归类的行为)

example.en: UNESCO urged the Italian government to undertake its responsibility to protect Venice.
example.zh: 联合国教科文组织敦促意大利政府承担起保护威尼斯的责任。
example.source: 真题 2018四级·06月·第2套·Section B·第41题·题干

example.en: More than drones dropping a new supply of underwear on your doorstep, Apple’s massively successful brick-and-mortar-and-glass retail stores and Amazon’s small steps in the same direction are what should keep old-fashioned retailers awake at night.
example.zh: 与其说是无人机把新内衣送到你家门口，不如说是苹果大获成功的实体玻璃零售店和亚马逊朝同一方向迈出的小步，才该让传统零售商夜不能寐。
example.source: 真题 2019六级·06月·第1套·Section B·正文

example.en: Science has long had an uneasy relationship with other aspects of culture.
example.zh: 科学长期以来与文化其他方面关系紧张。

definition_zh_all: 不平坦的， 不平滑的； 不一致的， 不相等的

phrases.zh: 意外的消息；出乎意料的新闻

definition_zh_all: 展开， 打开； 显露， 展现

example.en: A few generative rules are then sufficient to unfold the entire fundamental structure of a language, which is why children can learn it so quickly.
example.zh: 几条生成规则就足以展开一种语言的整个基本结构，这就是为什么儿童能如此迅速地学会它。

definition_zh_all: 使联合， 统一； 使相同， 使一致

example.en: But Pasternak did take note of one unifying factor in all of the healthy societies he observed.
example.zh: 但帕斯捷尔纳克确实注意到了他所观察到的所有健康社会中的一个统一因素。
example.source: 真题 2022四级·12月·第1套·Section C·正文

example.en: The French tax is not just a unilateral move by one country in need of revenue.
example.zh: 法国的税收不仅仅是一个需要收入的国家采取的单边行动。

definition_zh_all: 唯一的， 独一无二的； 极不寻常的， 极好的

example.en: The Eisenhower Executive Office Building (EEOB) commands a unique position in both the national history and the architectural heritage of the United States.
example.zh: 艾森豪威尔行政办公楼在美国国家历史和建筑遗产中都占据独特地位。
example.source: 真题 2018英语一·ordering·第41题·E选项·选项

phrases.zh: 唯一机会；极难得的机会

definition_zh_all: 单一， 统一， 团结； 和睦， 协调

phrases.zh: 团结就是力量；众志成城

definition_zh_all: 宇宙， 世界； 领域， 范围

example.en: this new generation of logicians and rationalists, more explanations for how the universe functioned were being made at a rate that the people could no longer ignore.
example.zh: 这一代新的逻辑学家和理性主义者，关于宇宙如何运作的解释正以人们再也无法忽视的速度不断涌现。

phrases.zh: n. 论域；讨论或辩论的范围

example.en: When Pandora’s box was opened, it unleashed swarms of diseases and disasters upon humankind.
example.zh: 当潘多拉的盒子被打开时，它向人类释放了成群的疾病和灾难。
example.source: 真题 2020六级·12月·第2套·Section B·正文

example.en: Writing for the National Immigration Forum, Gregory Rodriguez reports that today’s immigration is neither at unprecedented levels nor resistant to assimilation.
example.zh: 格雷戈里·罗德里格斯在为美国国家移民论坛撰文时指出，当今的移民既未达到前所未有的水平，也并非抗拒同化。

phrases.zh: 不稳定斜坡，不稳定边坡；不稳坡

example.en: China is the latest to implement an anti-trust crackdown, unveiling anti-monopoly rules last month.
example.zh: 中国是最新一个实施反垄断打击的国家，上月公布了反垄断规则。
example.source: 真题 2022六级·09月·第合卷套·Section C·正文

example.en: … because you’re ready for your stubborn supervisor’s pushback with answers like, “Actually, I connected with a few people in our tech department to discuss how much time these kinds of website updates would take, and they suggested they have the bandwidth.”
example.zh: ……因为你已经准备好应对固执主管的反对，可以这样回答：“实际上，我和技术部门的几个人沟通过，讨论这类网站更新需要多少时间，他们表示有足够的人手。”

example.en: the current international tax system needs upgrading.
example.zh: 当前国际税收体系需要升级。
example.source: 真题 2020英语一·Text 4·第38题·A选项·选项

example.en: Last April, for example, the justices signaled that too many patents were being upheld for “inventions” that are obvious.
example.zh: 例如，去年四月，法官们表示，太多显而易见的“发明”专利被维持有效。

example.en: Human height is conditioned by the upright posture.
example.zh: 人类身高受直立姿势的影响。
example.source: 真题 2008英语·Text 3·第33题·B选项·选项

example.en: Mobile-phone footage of Arab uprisings and American tornadoes is posted on social-networking sites and shown on television newscasts.
